## Hi, I'm Sarah

The home page is the ten-second version. This is the longer story.

I am an M.S. Data Science candidate at Willamette University with a strong
interest in reproducible analytics for mission-driven organizations. What keeps
me in this work is turning messy operational data into reporting that leaders
can trust and act on.

At Willamette, my emphasis has been data engineering, SQL-based warehouse
modeling, and dashboard quality assurance. My [capstone](capstone.qmd) brings
those areas together through an end-to-end reporting workflow for The Northwest
Hub.

### About the team

Spokes is a one-person capstone build led by Sarah Alhusaynat.

- Designed and validated ETL pulls from QuickBooks Online and Lightspeed.
- Modeled warehouse tables in Neon Postgres for board-reporting workflows.
- Built and verified Grafana data-health dashboards and artifact documentation.

### Beyond the terminal

- I enjoy community-centered projects and practical tools that reduce manual reporting work.
- I am currently deepening skills in analytics engineering and production data workflows.
- In the next two years, I want to contribute to data platforms that improve transparency and decisions in public-interest settings.
